title: Logarithmic Large Deviations for Heavy-Tailed Randomly Stopped Sums
summary: We derive logarithmic large-deviation asymptotics for randomly stopped sums with nonnegative summands satisfy a weak form of regular variation. Our approach is based on a count-scale condition that controls the logarithmic order of the random number of summands and does not require relative concentration around its expectation. A main advantage of the framework is that it applies to every renewal count, without moment, regular-variation, or domain-of-attraction assumptions on the interarrival distribution.
